newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Farm ministers delay veal decision until autumn.
newsitem.headline: Farm ministers delay veal decision until autumn.

text.p: European Union farm ministers on Tuesday delayed a decision to alter veal early marketing and calf slaughter premia until the autumn, an EU member state official said.
"The Council of Ministers asked the Commission to make a report in the autumn on the effectiveness of both schemes," a German official said on Tuesday.

France had asked for a cut in the veal early marketing premium and Britain for a cut in the calf slaughter premium. Both country's ministers copmplained that the premia were causing market distortions, the official said.
In March, the EU's beef management committee revised the early marketing premia for veal.
France complained that producers in the Netherlands were gaining a market advantage because their animals were heavier than those of French producers. REUTER
